posts.title: Resourceful Computing
posts.description: One common finding in psychology that I have noticed in my own behavior as well is that when you make resource-consumption visible, it becomes much easier to change your behavior towards being less wasteful. Ever since I added a CPU and RAM usage indicator to my OS system bar, I have become very concerned about how much RAM different things use or whether my laptop fans are spinning more than what
